theory.intro: The symbol $\equiv$ means 'is congruent to'. A **congruence statement** names both figures with their vertices in matching order, so it tells you every pair of corresponding sides and angles without a diagram.
facts: In $\triangle ABC \equiv \triangle XYZ$ the vertices match by position: $A \leftrightarrow X$, $B \leftrightarrow Y$ and $C \leftrightarrow Z$.
Corresponding sides are read off by position: $AB = XY$, $BC = YZ$ and $AC = XZ$.
Corresponding angles are read off by position: $\angle A = \angle X$, $\angle B = \angle Y$ and $\angle C = \angle Z$.
The letters may start at any vertex and run either way, but both sides must move together, so $\triangle BCA \equiv \triangle YZX$ says exactly the same thing.
steps: Identify the corresponding vertices, using the transformation or the matching marks.
Write the vertices in matching order on each side of $\equiv$.

foundation.solution_text:
After the slide the vertices match position for position: $P \leftrightarrow T$, $Q \leftrightarrow U$, $R \leftrightarrow V$.
$\triangle PQR \equiv \triangle TUV$

The reflection matches $A \leftrightarrow E$, $B \leftrightarrow D$ and $C \leftrightarrow F$.
$\triangle ABC \equiv \triangle EDF$

The slide matches $G \leftrightarrow Q$, $H \leftrightarrow N$ and $K \leftrightarrow P$.
$H$ corresponds to $N$.

The reflection matches $A \leftrightarrow M$ and $C \leftrightarrow N$.
Side $AC$ corresponds to side $MN$.

The half turn matches $P \leftrightarrow Y$, $Q \leftrightarrow Z$, $R \leftrightarrow W$ and $S \leftrightarrow X$.
$\angle R$ corresponds to $\angle W$.

The reflection matches $A \leftrightarrow Z$, $B \leftrightarrow Y$, $C \leftrightarrow X$ and $D \leftrightarrow W$.
$ABCD \equiv ZYXW$

The marks match $G \leftrightarrow M$ (single meets triple), $H \leftrightarrow N$ (single meets double) and $K \leftrightarrow P$ (double meets triple).
$\triangle GHK \equiv \triangle MNP$

development.solution_text:
The slide matches $J \leftrightarrow V$, $K \leftrightarrow T$, $L \leftrightarrow S$ and $M \leftrightarrow U$.
$JKLM \equiv VTSU$.
Corresponding angles are equal, so $\angle T = 115^{\circ}$.

The rotation matches $F \leftrightarrow N$, $G \leftrightarrow M$ and $H \leftrightarrow L$.
$\triangle FGH \equiv \triangle NML$.
Side $FG$ corresponds to side $NM$, so $FG = 8$ cm.

The figures are reflections, so the vertices in $\triangle PQR \equiv \triangle XYZ$ are not in matching order: $P$ corresponds to $Y$, not $X$.
Matching the vertices: $P \leftrightarrow Y$, $Q \leftrightarrow X$, $R \leftrightarrow Z$.
$\triangle PQR \equiv \triangle YXZ$

The half turn matches $A \leftrightarrow Z$, $B \leftrightarrow X$ and $C \leftrightarrow Y$.
$\triangle ABC \equiv \triangle ZXY$.

The rotation matches $C \leftrightarrow V$ and $D \leftrightarrow W$.
Side $CD$ corresponds to side $VW$.

The half turn matches $J \leftrightarrow S$, $K \leftrightarrow T$, $L \leftrightarrow U$ and $M \leftrightarrow V$.
$JKLM \equiv STUV$

mastery.solution_text:
The rotation matches $D \leftrightarrow T$, $E \leftrightarrow S$ and $F \leftrightarrow R$.
$\triangle DEF \equiv \triangle TSR$.
The vertex of $\angle RTS$ is $T$, which corresponds to $D$.
Corresponding angles are equal, so $\angle RTS = 74^{\circ}$.

The rotation matches $P \leftrightarrow X$, $Q \leftrightarrow W$, $R \leftrightarrow Z$ and $S \leftrightarrow Y$.
$PQRS \equiv XWZY$.
Side $PQ$ corresponds to side $XW$, so $PQ = 8.5$ cm.

The single-tick side $AB$ matches $RQ$, the double-tick side $BC$ matches $QT$, and the triple-tick side $CD$ matches $TS$.
So $A \leftrightarrow R$, $B \leftrightarrow Q$, $C \leftrightarrow T$ and $D \leftrightarrow S$.
$ABCD \equiv RQTS$
